SELECT fs.week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (s.store_id, p.sku)) AS n_store_sku, count(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS stores,
  sum(fs.closing_units) AS units, sum(fs.closing_value) AS val,
  sum(fs.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) AS val_recalc,
  sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_rows,
  sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_val
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
  AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.category AS cat_was, cp.category AS cat_now, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT p.sku) skus
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (p.category='Paint & Decorating' OR cp.category='Paint & Decorating') GROUP BY 1,2

SELECT 'cat_versions' AS chk, p.sku::VARCHAR AS k, string_agg(DISTINCT p.category, ' > ') AS v
FROM dim_product p WHERE p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE category='Paint & Decorating') GROUP BY p.sku HAVING count(DISTINCT p.category)>1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'max_row', fs.week_ending_date::VARCHAR, max(fs.closing_units)::VARCHAR || ' units / ' || max(fs.closing_value)::VARCHAR || ' eur / min units ' || min(fs.closing_units)::VARCHAR
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND p.category='Paint & Decorating' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_in_scope', s.store_id::VARCHAR || ' ' || s.store_name, s.region || ' ' || s.format || ' cur=' || s.is_current::VARCHAR

calls.statement:
WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT fs.week_ending_date, SUM(fs.closing_value) AS closing_value
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
      AND s.store_id < 900
      AND cp.category = 'Paint & Decorating'
    GROUP BY fs.week_ending_date
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 3 AS fiscal_period, 'Paint & Decorating' AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS weeks, ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value_at_cost_eur
FROM weekly
